title: We're building an agentic workspace for Unreal Engine, and we're giving free early access to users for feedback
author: creatormaximalist
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I'm part of the team at Bezi, where we're building an AI agent that works inside your game engine. I've posted our Unity updates here a few times before, and today I wanted to share that we've brought it to Unreal Engine. [Registration for early access](https://www.bezi.com/unreal) is open, and we're looking for testers.

Bezi can now:

* Author and edit Blueprints, new or existing (placing nodes, setting variables, wiring execution and data pins)
* Build and edit materials (texture samples, parameters, material outputs)
* Assemble PCG graphs from rules you give it
* Start Play In Editor, drive the inputs, and play through the session for automated QA
* And the everyday stuff (C++ and .ini files, levels, Game Mode and Pawn setup, Niagara, etc.)

https://reddit.com/link/1wtf6oa/video/2zxamkblmhsh1/player

It's early, and it'll be rough in places. That's why it's completely free for as long as early access runs. We'd love for you to push it and tell us where it is lacking and how we can improve the tool. Native Perforce integration and animation are up next.

Some things to know:

* It needs Unreal Engine 5.4 or above.
* It is completely free to use while we are in early access.
* Bezi edits your project files directly, so its changes show up in source control like your own, and you revert them the same way.
* Registering puts you on the waitlist. We're seating testers in batches, so it won't be instant.

If you work in Unreal, especially if you spend your days in Blueprints, materials, or PCG, you can register for the early access here: [https://www.bezi.com/unreal](https://www.bezi.com/unreal)

We're also taking questions and feedback in our [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/bezi).

As always, happy to answer anything in the comments or over DM. Any and all feedback is appreciated!
